decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering the BOM-relevant connector, resistor, and population changes.
The new charge-LED circuit does not change the battery NTC connection or thermal-protection behavior.
The source changes charge-LED components R6 and D1, not the battery-protection controller or DW01A protection components.
J_LED_CHG is a separate charge-LED connector and does not alter the J_BAT connector family, pin count, functions, or unresolved pin order.
The charge-LED circuit does not change the MT3608 enable control, default state, or powered loads.
The dedicated J_LED_CHG connector is not one of the interboard power or signal connectors and does not change their partition or pinout.
Adding a future dedicated charge LED does not replace or alter the retained SK6812 addressable-LED chain or its GPIO13 data interface.
R6 is part of the charge-LED circuit; the source does not change the I2C pull-ups or retained zero-ohm I2C resistors.
The source adds circuitry and a connector to the existing power board rather than adding, removing, or repartitioning a board.
The source requires J_LED_CHG but makes no decision about its placement, orientation, mounting-hole clearance, or battery-connector accessibility.
The power-board charge-LED connector does not change the sensor board's external-sensor fanout role.
The new charge-LED connector and resistor changes do not affect USB data lines, USB connector sourcing, or the interboard USB route.
